cards.title: Siam Mapped: A History of the Geo-Body of a Nation กําเนิดสยามจากแผนที่
cards.authors: Thongchai Winichakul, ธงชัย วินิจจะกุล, Phūangthō̜ng Phawakkhawan, ʻAidā ʻArunwong, Phonglœ̄t Phongwanān
cards.publisher: Aan Press and Kobfai Project
cards.edition: Phim khrang rǣk, กรุงเทพฯ Krung Thēp, 2013
cards.description: This unusual and intriguing study of nationhood explores the 19th-century confrontation of ideas that transformed the kingdom of Siam into the modern conception of a nation. Siam Mapped challenges much that has been written on Thai history because it demonstrates convincingly that the physical and political definition of Thailand on which other works are based is anachronistic.
